description.en-US: The original texts of Chalcedon (451): the canons in Greek (from the Pedalion) and the ancient Latin version of its decrees. The English translation of Percival (NPNF, 1900) is the book Councils: Chalcedon (451).
description.pt-BR: Os textos originais de Calcedônia (451): os cânones em grego (do Pedálion) e a antiga versão latina de seus decretos.

grc.editor: Nicodemus the Hagiorite and Agapius, Pedalion (Leipzig 1800), via Greek Wikisource

la.editor: Conciliorum Oecumenicorum Decreta (Bologna 1962), ancient Latin versions, via Latin Wikisource / Documenta Catholica Omnia

sources.edition: Greek Wikisource, Κανόνες Δ΄ Οικουμενικής Συνόδου, the canon text of the Pedalion (Nicodemus the Hagiorite and Agapius, 1800). Wikitext fetched through action=raw.
sources.description: The canons only. Nicodemus's prolegomena and his commentary (Ἑρμηνεία) are not included; the creed, definition and letters of the council are not in this source.
sources.tierEvidence: Canons of the fourth to eighth centuries; Pedalion printed 1800.

sources.edition: Latin Wikisource, Concilium Chalcedonense, the text of Conciliorum Oecumenicorum Decreta (Bologna 1962) as circulated by Documenta Catholica Omnia (the ancient Latin versions of the Greek acts). Wikitext fetched through action=raw.
sources.description: As transcribed. The digitisation has its punctuation largely stripped, no capitals at the start of sentences and lowercase deus/dominus; line breaks kept as paragraph breaks, split enclitics rejoined, and the digitisation's citation lines (pag./linea) removed.
sources.tierEvidence: Ancient texts; the digitisation derives from the Library of Latin Texts / COD text (a critical edition of 1962/1973), which carries at most a neighbouring right that has run out and is freely redistributed by Wikisource and Documenta Catholica Omnia.
